radius.label: player radius
radius.tip: px; the player is 19 (as2/player.as), so floor narrower than twice this is not walkable

safe.label: safe zone
safe.tip: px of walking distance around the entrance with no enemies

features.label: Entrance and exit
features.tip: The entrance and exit go as far apart as the walkable floor allows.

clearance.label: clearance
clearance.tip: px of open floor around each

boxes.label: Boxes
boxes.tip: Crates in small groups along the walls, some carrying a drop picked from what the levels already drop.

drops.label: drop share
drops.tip: share of boxes that drop something

big.label: big share
big.tip: share drawn bigger, with more health

paths.label: Path nodes
paths.tip: Nodes over the wide open floor; each links to the nodes it can see when the level starts.

clearance.label: clearance
clearance.tip: px of open floor a node needs, so tanks fit

enemies.label: Enemies
enemies.tip: Turrets where they see the most floor, tanks and drones on the path network. Mix weights pick the symbols.

range.label: view range
range.tip: px a turret is scored on seeing

doors.label: Doors
doors.tip: Doors across narrow passages on the way to the exit; each is opened by a trigger pad somewhere the player can already reach.

maxWidth.label: max gap
maxWidth.tip: widest passage a door may close, px

minSide.label: min side
minSide.tip: each side of a door must hold this share of the floor
